#2905: channel brand values are text-safe per mode (brand, action and focus share one shade per channel mode; dark modes pair it with dark text); the Readiness/Trust panel links read --k-action with a --k-brand fallback; the dock resize grip uses --text-primary on hover/focus. Documented the brand-as-text surfaces and channel-text-contrast.test.tsx, which measures rendered text (4.5:1) and the dock grips (3:1) on their real backdrops. Ran branding-role-cascade and channel-text-contrast in Chromium.
